# tests

What every test binary is built with (iclforge::test_support) and the performance tests.

A tests.

- **Uses:** `ac3`, `ac4`, `dsp`
- **Used by:** nothing
- **CI lanes:** core

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build.
